reason: Losing that regular over a double-booking still stings, so I get what this fixes, but my whiteboard, Excel and Xero work and I just don't have the hours to learn a new system and get the drivers using an app. A brand-new company with no other operators on it isn't something I'll bet my bookings on in a normal week.
objection: I don't have time to learn new software, and with no customers yet I'd be the one finding the bugs. If it stuffs up a wedding or a school run, that's my name on it, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to another small charter operator like me who has run it for a few months and says it actually stopped the clashes without eating their evenings.
